test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. N is sitting third to the left of P. M is sitting third to the left of N. O is sitting third to the left of M. M is sitting between O and N. N is sitting between M and P. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) N is sitting third to the left of P.

2) M is sitting third to the left of N.

3) O is sitting third to the left of M.

4) M is sitting between O and N.

5) N is sitting between M and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2552e4d9d5a68357c8ae14bbdcf3182fedfd62e91fcade3d613c6d0a5575fa53.png] 

If no other person is sitting in the row, Total '10' persons seated in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
